About

Background

I'm a junior at the University of Central Florida studying Digital Media – Game Design with a minor in Computer Science. I specialize in gameplay programming — mainly C# and Blueprint — and I'm building out hand-written C++ and graphics programming skills through the projects above. Most of my work has heavy programming/scripting contribution, whether solo or on a small team.

Outside of programming, I've worked as a Shopify web developer, co-founded a mural club that painted five murals for my high school library, supported backstage production as part of a theater tech team, and tutored math for several years.
